edited: Which observatory stations (`observstation`) have an average telescope bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) above the overall average bandwidth usage? Ignore missing values. For each one, show the station, its average bandwidth usage, and how much it exceeds the overall average. Return the top 10 by that margin, largest first, without rounding. Compute the overall average across all telescopes with nonmissing bandwidth usage.

Which observatory stations (`observstation`) have an average telescope bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) above the overall average bandwidth usage? Ignore missing values. For each one, show the station, its average bandwidth usage, and how much it exceeds the overall average. Return the top 10 by that margin, largest first, without rounding. Compute the overall average as the unweighted mean of station averages.
queries:
WITH overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
    FROM telescopes
    WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
),
station_averages AS (
    SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
    FROM telescopes
    WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY observstation
)
SELECT
    s.observstation,
    s.avg_usage,
    s.avg_usage - o.avg_usage AS margin
FROM station_averages AS s
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE s.avg_usage > o.avg_usage
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH station_averages AS (
    SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
    FROM telescopes
    GROUP BY observstation
    HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) IS NOT NULL
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
    FROM station_averages
)
SELECT
    s.observstation,
    s.avg_bandusagepct,
    s.avg_bandusagepct - o.avg_bandusagepct AS margin
FROM station_averages AS s
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE s.avg_bandusagepct > o.avg_bandusagepct
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10
